moduli_groups.description: List of Diffie-Hellman prime groups for SSH key exchange. Each group defines its size, type, generator, and prime modulus.

bits.description: Prime size in bits (e.g., 2048, 3072, 4096). Larger values provide more security but require more computation.

type.description: Group type. '2' = safe prime (Sophie Germain), '3' = modulus of form 2^p - 1 (Mersenne), etc. Type 2 is standard for SSH.

generator.description: Generator (as hexadecimal string) used for the group. Typically '2' or '5'.

modulus.description: Prime modulus in hexadecimal. Must be a cryptographically strong prime of the specified bit length.

comment.description: Optional human-readable comment (e.g., 'NIST FIPS 186-2 modp group').
